title: B1142 HVAC Repair; Out of Scope Roof Modification
description: This document approves the award of a modification to a Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Task Order (TO) Under contract FA251720D0004 under the Front Range Multiple Award Construction Contract (FRMACC) Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ). The current TO FA251725F0154 is to provide HVAC work at Building 1142 (Project TDKA 10-1128). The intended action is to modify the current TO and include roof and lighting work for B1142. The justification is to award a modification to aforementioned on-going TO as it is in the interest of efficiency and economy. It is economically sound due to heavy equipment rentals/laborers/etc. that are already scheduled to be on site, alleviating additional mobilization and demobilization costs for a potentially different contractor if competed and awarded other than sole-source. This new requirement for roof replacement, lighting replacement, and interior finishes repair directly overlaps with ongoing work in the facility being performed by the current contractor. The Contractor is familiar with the facility, is in direct control of the construction schedule of HVAC replacement scope already awarded, and can execute the additional scope identified at a lower cost and shorter timeframe than other FRMACC contractors due to the efficiency of de-conflicting overlapping scopes. Positive impacts include assurance of proper sequencing of integrated work to avoid duplication of efforts and costs, elimination of warranty conflicts between contracts, and reduction of mission impact to execute consolidated scope in tandem in lieu of extended, multiple efforts displacing the mission owner on multiple occasions. Examples of overlapping scope with potential for duplicated costs and time include rooftop unit and associated curb placement/detailing on roof, roof-mounted utilities impacted by roof replacement, lighting and interior HVAC rework in tandem with ceiling replacement. Additionally, the roof conditions of this facility are in severe need of repair to mitigate ongoing mission impact in the facility, and are essential to be executed with urgency and without delay related to current awarded HVAC replacement work. This modification was executed by the 21st Contracting Squadron, located at 135 Dover St, Bldg 350, Suite 2225, Peterson Space Force Base, CO 80914. Olgoonik Enterprises, LLC (CAGE: 819A4) received the awarded modification for new work in the amount of $1,355,810.00. The modification was executed on 09/25/2026. Please submit all questions/concerns to the Contracting Officer at frederick.chartrand@spaceforce.mil.

description: THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) ONLY. This is not a Request for Quotation (RFQ), Request for Proposal (RFP) or an Invitation for Bid (IFB). The Program Manager � Protection and Integration (PM-PI) is seeking feedback on draft #2 of Military Detail document aka MIL-DTL for a new design for military connections. This draft incorporated comments from draft #1 and is subject to change based on relevant feedback and other developmental milestones of the program. Militarized USB-C aka �USB-CM� is an environmentally hardened connection built to survive military environments. The connector supports power and data requirements and supports USB standards unless specifically stated otherwise. This government owned design is intended to provide a standard interface for military equipment and is not proprietary. USB-CM is intended to provide a reliable and ruggedized standard connector for users across the Department of War in their deployed terrestrial, maritime: surface and sub-surface, air, and space operational environment(s). title: INTELLIGENCE, SURVEILLANCE, ANDRECONNAISSANCE (ISR) SYSTEMS AND INFORMATION OPERATIONS (IO) FROM SEABED TO SPACE (S2ISR)
description: Note: A Market Survey to Assess Small Business Capability was posted for this procurement on 05 March 2025 under E-Commerce control number MKTSVY-0019F306, REFERENCE NUMBER: N6600125R0025. The Naval Information Warfare Center (NIWC) Pacific intends to issue Request for Proposal (RFP) No. N6600126R0019 for Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) Systems and Information Operations (IO) from Seabed to Space (S2ISR). The services contemplated under this effort will provide the Navy with the ability to develop and field ISR systems that incorporate the latest capabilities for maintaining robust communication, surveillance, and security to accommodate advances in technology and other complementary systems while countering ever-increasing threats. The Government contemplates that, in its capacity, the contractor will provide technical support services in the form of algorithm development, data design processing, hardware and software development, fabrication, installation, testing, deployment, recovery, repair, systems engineering, program and configuration management, logistics, maintenance, sustainment, training, environmental support, and analysis in support of ISR activities, ISR systems, and corresponding cybersecurity operations. ISR activities may include support related to chemical, nuclear, biological, and radiological (CNBR) elements related to unmanned system. ISR systems may include surveillance programs, systems, networks, and tactical data communications systems including automated radio communications systems, satellite terminal systems, and space, air, land and water autonomous or non-autonomous systems that could be used in ISR operations. Contract activities may be performed throughout the world. In addition, work may be performed onboard afloat vessels (including U.S. Coast Guard vessels), in port, or at sea alongside coalition partner nations (e.g., NATO countries). It is anticipated that the procurement will result in the award of multiple indefinite-delivery, indefinite quantity (IDIQ) contracts with cost-plus-fixed-fee (CPFF) and cost (no fee) pricing arrangements. The period of performance will include a seven-year ordering period. Orders will be placed pursuant to the ordering processes of FAR 16.505(a). The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 541715 Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering and Life Sciences, excluding nanotechnology and biotechnology and the Small Business Size Standard is 1,000. Security classification will vary from Unclassified to Top Secret/Incidental Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) classification. This requirement will be competed on a full-and-open basis. This is a follow-on requirement covered by contracts N6600121D0053 through 0063. NIWC Pacific anticipates that the final RFP for N6600126R0019 will be released no earlier than 21 November 2025. The solicitation will be available electronically via the Solicitation Module within the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) website at https://piee.eb.mil, under Notice ID N6600126R0019.

description: Request for Information (RFI) : Obtaining Food Franchise Rights in Washington, DC - Northern Capital Region (NCR) The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) to gather detailed input from qualified organizations regarding the requirements, processes, and opportunities associated with obtaining food franchise rights within the Northern Capital Region (NCR), Washington, DC. Organizations responding to this RFI are requested to provide all relevant documentation, points of contact, marketing materials, and procedural information. This RFI is for planning and informational purposes only and does not obligate the Government to pursue any further action or future solicitation. Direct Engagement Model � Industry Feedback Requested In addition to information on obtaining food franchise rights generally, the FBI is specifically interested in understanding the feasibility and attractiveness of a direct-engagement model, in which the FBI would contract or otherwise arrange directly with individual food franchise brands (rather than through a single master food-service contractor) to provide food service operations within the J. Edgar Hoover Building (JEH), Washington, DC. What the FBI should understand about this model: Typical franchise agreement structures, term lengths, and capital investment requirements (buildout, equipment, branding) when a franchisor/franchisee operates within a federal government-controlled facility rather than a traditional commercial or retail location Licensing, royalty, and territory considerations that may apply or require modification for a single-tenant government building Food safety, supply chain, and operational standards the franchise would need to meet or adapt to operate within a secure federal facility Any precedent for franchise operations within federal buildings, military installations, or other access-controlled environments, and lessons learned from those arrangements All responses must be submitted to: Ms. McKenzie P. Bucher, mpbucher@fbi.gov Mr. Tom Teets, twteets@fbi.gov Please provide all requested information no later than September 21, 2026, at 12:00 PM EDT.

title: Netherlands – Public road transport services – Mobiliteitskaarten en aanverwante dienstverlening
description: Per 2026 zijn in de cao Werken voor Waterschappen nieuwe mobiliteitsafspraken opgenomen. Eén van deze afspraken is dat de werkgever de werknemer op diens verzoek een openbaarvervoerkaart ter beschikking kan stellen in ruil voor de bestaande vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer. De directie van Waterschap AGV heeft op basis van het directievoorstel mobiliteitsregeling AGV besloten de mobiliteitsregeling in te voeren. Daarbij heeft de directie als uitgangspunten vastgesteld dat de regeling moet bijdragen aan: • duurzamer reisgedrag van medewerkers; • goed werkgeverschap; • het stimuleren van aanwezigheid en ontmoeting op kantoor; • een uitvoerbare en beheersbare inrichting van processen en systemen. Om deze directiekeuze tijdig, rechtmatig en doelmatig te kunnen uitvoeren, is het noodzakelijk een geschikte marktpartij te contracteren voor de levering en uitvoering van de openbaar vervoer voorziening. Het inkooptraject is erop gericht een contractpartij te selecteren die niet alleen de mobiliteitskaart levert, maar ook de bijbehorende dienstverlening kan bieden die nodig is voor implementatie, beheer, rapportage, ondersteuning van gebruikers en een verwerkbare aansluiting op HR-, financiële en salarisprocessen.

description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europees openbare procedure conform de hoofdstuk 2 ARW 2016. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Deelnemers zijn naast de Gemeente Breda: Gemeente Alphen-Chaam, Gemeente Baarle-Nassau, Gemeente Gilze en Rijen, Baarle-Hertog en Gemeente Etten-Leur. Opdracht De opdracht betreft het reinigen en het preventief en correctief onderhouden van de mechanische installaties 2027-2028 binnen de deelnemende gemeenten van het Samenwerkingsverband Waterbeheer West-Brabant (SWWB). Percelen Deze opdracht is verdeeld in de volgende percelen: Perceel 1: ABG-organisatie (Gemeente Alphen-Chaam, Gemeente Baarle-Nassau en Gemeente Gilze en Rijen) en Baarle-Hertog; Perceel 2: Gemeente Etten-Leur; Perceel 3: Gemeente Breda. Doel Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om voor de dienstverlening per perceel een raamovereenkomst te sluiten met één opdrachtnemer met een looptijd van 2 jaar met als ingangsdatum 1 januari 2027. De opdrachtgever heeft het recht deze overeenkomst, met tweemaal met één jaar te verlengen. De opdrachtgever zal minimaal 6 maanden voor het aflopen van het contract, de aannemer schriftelijk op de hoogte stellen of de opdrachtgever van de optie tot verlenging van het contract gebruik zal maken. Anders eindigt het contract automatisch na het bereiken van de einddatum. Minimale termijn van 6 maanden geldt ook voor de optie jaren. Eventuele verlenging geschiedt onder gelijkblijvende condities en voorwaarden. description: The required services encompass the highly specialized technical, operational, database, and security administration support necessary to sustain the legacy CMiC eCMS application, while simultaneously executing the technical migration of historical project data to the follow-on Kahua system. Continuous operation of this application is vital to the NAVFAC enterprise mission, as it enables quality control workflows between thousands of external construction contractors, Contracting Officer�s Representatives (CORs), Construction Quality Management (CQM) personnel, and Project Managers. While the follow-on eCMS 2.0 contract (N39430-25-C-0010) was successfully competed and awarded to Procon Consulting LLC (Procon) in August 2025, two major, unforeseen external factors stalled the planned transition schedule: 1. A 43-day partial federal government shutdown at the start of Fiscal Year 2026 (FY26). 2. Complex, multi-agency coordination required to obtain the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Provisional Authorization (PA) for the new Kahua Cloud Service Provider (CSP) environment. These disruptions created an execution gap that halted database migration tasks requiring proprietary database schema coordination between Bahfed and Procon. A one-year sole-source extension of Bahfed's services is required to bridge this execution gap, maintain the secure cloud hosting environment, deploy security hotfixes, and finalize the structured data transfer to the new competitive platform. The estimated value of this 12-month extension is $3,500,000, based on the Independent Government Cost Estimate (IGCE). The requirement will be funded using Operations & Maintenance, Navy (O&M,N) appropriations.

title: Switzerland – Construction work – Montagebau in Holz
description: Der geplante Neubau des Primarschulhauses Allmend verfolgt das Ziel, eine zukunftsfähige, nachhaltige und pädagogisch funktionale Infrastruktur für die Primarstufe 1 bis 6 zu schaffen. Der viergeschossige Baukörper wird in konventioneller Holzbauweise auf dem Schulareal errichtet und ersetzt dort die bestehende Aussensportanlage („Roter Platz“). Die geologischen und hydrogeologischen Rahmenbedingungen auf dem Areal gelten als anspruchsvoll. Es sind insbesondere zwei voneinander zu trennende Grundwasserstockwerke zu berücksichtigen. Der Baugrund verlangt eine Pfahlgründung (Betonverdrängungsbohrpfähle), auch für Werkleitungen und Kontrollschächte (Holzpfähle). Im Hinblick auf den Hochwasserschutz erfüllt der Neubau die Anforderungen HQ300- Die Haustechnik wird im Erdgeschoss und obersten Geschoss platziert (kein UG), um Schäden durch Hochwasserereignisse zu vermeiden. Die Tragstruktur des Gebäudes basiert auf einem Massivholzskelett aus Fi/Ta. Ergänzt wird dieses durch drei massive Servicekerne aus Stahlbeton. Die Wendeltreppen zwischen den Servicekernen sind ebenfalls in Stahlbeton ausgeführt. Die Fassade besteht aus vorgefertigten Holzständer-Aussenelementen. Das Gebäude wird nach SNBS 2.1 Hochbau zertiﬁziert (Ziel ist Gold Zertiﬁzierung). Direct recovery of Te metal and Cd for reintegration into module production. Electricity-driven process supports integration with renewable or nuclear power, lowering lifecycle emissions. Key Advantages Reduced environmental impact: Avoids carbon-intensive bulk chemical manufacturing. Lower logistical burden: Minimizes transportation and storage of hazardous oxidants. Clean energy compatible: Process can run on renewable or low-carbon electricity. Next-generation mining model: Enables sustainable materials recovery aligned with circular economy goals. Market Applications CdTe photovoltaic recycling: Direct application to commercial operations, such as First Solar�s module recovery. (i) The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Center for Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases (NCEZID), Division of Healthcare Quality Promotion (DHQP), announces its intent to compete a new Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract vehicle titled �Safety, Prevention, Epidemiology, and Education Development for Health Care and Antimicrobial Resistance (SPEED).� SPEED will provide CDC with an "as needed" mechanism to obtain healthcare epidemiology, health behavior, and healthcare-associated infection research support across five functional domains: (1) Domestic Antimicrobial Resistance, Infection Prevention and Control, and Adverse Events Services; (2) Healthcare Information Technology and Data Solutions Services; (3) Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Infection Prevention and Control Services; (4) Emergency Preparedness, Response Services, and Healthcare System Resilience Services; and (5) Workforce Training, Message Development, Dissemination, and Testing Services. The anticipated ordering period (period of performance) for the SPEED IDIQ is a 60-month period beginning on March 30, 2027 and ending March 29, 2032. Offerors may submit proposals to one or more domains and will be evaluated on technical approach including existing infrastructure and capacity, staffing approach, management approach, similar experience, price, and past performance. To ensure continuity of critical healthcare epidemiology and infection prevention research support with no lapse in service, DHQP extended the current Safe Healthcare, Epidemiology, Prevention Research Development (SHEPheRD) Program contracts through March 29, 2027, the day immediately preceding the SPEED anticipated effective start date. This extension allows CDC to maintain uninterrupted access to essential scientific, technical, and programmatic support while the SPEED solicitation, evaluation, and award process is completed. DHQP intends for SPEED to fully replace SHEPheRD upon award. CDC will provide further information regarding the solicitation timeline, evaluation criteria, and instructions for interested offerors in forthcoming notices. Interested parties are encouraged to monitor SAM.gov for the official solicitation and any applicable updates. SPEED shall consist of 5 Domains briefly described as follows: Domain 1: Domestic Antimicrobial Resistance, Infection Prevention and Control, and Adverse Events Services. The purpose of this domain is to obtain services that support the design, execution, and assessment of healthcare and community epidemiology research initiatives addressing antimicrobial resistance (AR), infection prevention and control (IPC), and adverse events domestically within U.S. healthcare settings and communities. These implementation services include developing and implementing study protocols, conducting clinical and epidemiologic investigations, evaluating outcomes, and translating research findings into scalable, evidence-based public health interventions. Domain 2: Healthcare Information Technology and Data Solutions Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services for the development and deployment of digital health systems, advanced analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and machine learning-driven tools, and mathematical modeling to strengthen surveillance, automate data processing, improve data quality, and enhance decision-making across health programs. This includes the ability of Offerors to develop, implement, or maintain healthcare or ancillary medical (e.g., laboratory, pharmacy, etc.) surveillance systems, deploy natural language processing applications and other artificial intelligence tools, conduct human factors engineering, and apply mathematical modeling to optimize system usability, workflow efficiency, and data interpretation Domain 3: Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Infection Prevention and Control Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services for development and implementation of research projects and protocols focused on antimicrobial stewardship, antimicrobial resistance detection and control, global health coordination, surveillance, and prevention of healthcare-associated infections in global healthcare settings. These tasks include, but are not limited to, conducting program evaluations, clinical investigations, cost effectiveness and disease modeling analyses, and translating findings into scalable and sustainable public health interventions with a particular focus on low- and middle-income countries. Domain 4: Emergency Preparedness, Response Services, and Healthcare System Resilience Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services to rapidly respond to healthcare quality and safety threats. Services that may be conducted under this domain include supporting CDC's ability to respond effectively and rapidly to outbreaks, emergencies, and public health threats during times of healthcare facility or health system stress or strain. Domain 5: Workforce Training, Message Development, Dissemination and Testing Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services that strengthen the capacity, knowledge, and preparedness of healthcare workers, public health personnel (including CDC staff), and the general public to prevent infections and reduce the spread of antimicrobial resistance and other infectious disease threats. title: Prefabricated construction in wood
description:
The existing Allmend school building was constructed in 1951 and expanded with annexes about two years later. For many years, the available space has been insufficient; consequently, since 2015, school classes have had to be accommodated in temporary structures known as the "Palazzine." Today, the existing school building and the Palazzine house a total of 16 primary school classes and one kindergarten. However, these temporary structures have reached the end of their service life, as has the pavilion on Bachstrasse, which houses two additional kindergartens.

The new building facilitates modern forms of learning, with rooms and spaces that can be adapted to changing needs. The construction of the new Allmend school building will free up the existing building for use by kindergartens, supplementary day-care facilities, and other school-related services.

title: OSTWIND Market Development 2027–2029
description:
Current Situation

OSTWIND and the participating cantons aim to shift commuter traffic toward public transportation and other sustainable modes of transportation. During the current contract period, data-driven potential analyses, business development activities, corporate mobility concepts, licensing agreements, and operational processes were established. Ongoing corporate projects will continue beyond the end of the current contract.


The contractor must therefore fulfill two tasks simultaneously: attract new companies or clusters of companies with high potential for shifting to public transit, and ensure the continuity of existing projects. The contract is structured as a comprehensive service, ranging from market prioritization and negotiations to stable implementation, ongoing support and further development, as well as an orderly handover.


Crucial is the contractor’s ability to design effective processes, coordinate them with OSTWIND and the contracting cantons, put them into operation, monitor them, and further develop them. Proprietary solutions that serve to fulfill the objectives of this contract may be offered separately to corporate clients, provided that the client’s own or other suitable implementation methods are supported to an equivalent degree and that economic interests and dependencies are disclosed transparently.


Project Objectives

The project aims to use data to identify suitable companies and locations with significant relocation potential, approach them, and persuade them to adopt corporate mobility concepts. In collaboration with the companies (clients), OSTWIND, the contracting cantons, and other partners, economically and operationally viable solutions are to be developed and brought to the decision-making stage.


The agreed-upon mobility concepts are to be translated into functional and manageable operational processes, supported throughout the contract period, and further developed based on usage and impact. At the same time, existing company projects must continue without interruption, and the necessary conditions for a future handover and sustainable continued operation must be established. Annual targets (e.g., acquisition of [number] companies with [number] employees, etc.) will be agreed upon with the contractor.


General Terms and Conditions

OSTWIND is awarding a contract for the term from January 1, 2027, to December 31, 2029. There are two options to extend the contract by one year each (maximum contract term: 5 years). OSTWIND has sole discretion to decide whether to exercise the extension options. The decision to extend the mandate is made separately for each option year. Exercising the first extension option does not confer any entitlement to a further one-year extension.


The contractor bears overall responsibility for the methodological, organizational, and procedural integration of the defined work packages. The scope covers the OSTWIND fare network area and the cantons participating in the program: AI, AR, GL, SG, SH, TG, SZ (March only). The focus is on employers, business locations, and clusters with significant potential for sustainable workplace mobility and a substantial connection to public transportation. Municipalities, cantons, transportation companies, and complementary mobility providers will be involved as needed.


The targeted performance objectives are set forth in the tender documents and the associated appendices. The quantities specified serve as planning guidelines and do not constitute a purchase guarantee, unless expressly stated otherwise.


Components of the Request for Proposals

Appendix 1: Requirements Catalog

Appendix 2: Case Study

Appendix 3: References and Key Personnel

Appendix 4: Price Sheet

In the event of discrepancies in the level of detail between the Terms of Reference and an appendix, the specific provisions of the relevant appendix shall apply to the respective subject matter.

Eventuele verlenging geschiedt onder gelijkblijvende condities en voorwaarden. title: Norway – Repair and maintenance services – Maintenance and further development of ServiceNow
description: Purpose Norsk Tipping (NT) currently uses ServiceNow, among other things, as IT Service Management and CSM tools and currently has a licence and maintenance agreement through DXC Technology. The contract expires in February 2027 and this procurement is a renewal of the maintenance contract for ServiceNow. NT is looking for a professional cooperation partner who can help maintain and further develop the current system. Tenderers must see possibilities, propose improvements and have good routines for development and support. The CSM module is used by Customer Service (Interactions/Case), Dealer service and some other small user groups (Case). Customer service is among norway's best and requires high efficiency in case handling with focus on quick access to information, getting pressure and high system degree. The system bears the mark that it has lived for almost 10 years. There are some technical debts that we need help cleaning up. Part of this is moving some internal APIs, which have been made available with MID-server, over to exposed facade services which are more responsive. The ITSM module is used to a very large degree by IT Operations, but also on customer service, dealer services (incident) and in Security. The case types in use are: incident, major incident, problem, change and request. NP's internal Service Desk and HR use Agent Workspace. ServiceDesk receives cases via the user portal, chat, telephone, attendance and e-mails that are automatically registered in ServiceNow. The case types they work with are primarily incident and request. It is a well developed Change management with a number of automated standard changes. ServiceNow is receiving more and more changes via pipeline or other integrations from internal Jira. The operational centre is the escalation point for general errors in the systems. They have monitoring and use, among other things, Splunk to receive events. Emphasis will be put on the tenderer ́s experience and competence in addition to operation and maintenance. Tenderers shall be a proactive consultant for the entire spectrum of services the contract covers. Whether there is new functionality in ServiceNow, a need for clearing in technical debts, smart choices around integrations, utilisation of functionality in the existing system based on the supplier knowing NP's business needs or the like. Requirements that shall be met. Norsk Tipping has organised development work in a product development model. The Customer Support product area is responsible for i.a. management and further development of ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud and self-service systems. Developers and consultants from the chosen supplier in this procurement will be important resources in this team together with other internal and external resources. NT has few, but good internal resources with competence in ServiceNow, and it is important to have a professional supplier that provides me good access to resources and who can contribute with expert help. As a starting point, the team consists of a system manager/owner and two system administrators, one of whom is defined as a team architect. The product development area currently consists of two multi-disciplinary teams, but which share internal resources and to a large degree work across. The product development manager has management responsibility for the teams and has, in addition, a team management role for the teams, in order to ensure progress and prioritising tasks. The product area is responsible for the management assignments being carried out and together prioritise small and large assignments based on the company principles for product development. The product development area follows the company ́s development cycle together with the other 12 areas and a joint plan is carried out at a general level, approx. 3 times per annum. The detailed planning will mainly be carried out in 2-week sprinters. Errors that occur are continually corrected as well as ongoing work in the other processes. The tenderer is expected to have competence in the following main areas. The list is not exhaustive: · ServiceNow platform · Licenses · Administration · Development · Integrations and integration security · Active and proactive consulting (ServiceNow and technology/architecture) · Coordination and planning · Work in multi-disciplinary teams · SLA and support Norsk Tipping currently has an agreement with DXC for ServiceNow. The agreement includes both consultancy services for the operation, management and further development of ServiceNow, as well as ServiceNow licences. The two parts of the existing agreement have different lengths. The agreement on consultancy services expires 27 February 2027, while the existing agreement on ServiceNow licences runs until February 2029. A new contract that will be signed as a result of this competition shall include both consultancy services and ServiceNow licences.

title: Norway – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – 1105601 UiO Life Sciences user equipment. K935.11 Super resolution microscope
description: Statsbygg is building the new Life Science Building (LVB) for the University of Oslo and Oslo University Hospital on behalf of the Ministry of Education and Research and South-East Health as with the contracting authority. The building shall be the workplace for approx. 1,600 employees and 1,600 students. Start up for the excavation and ground work was the second quarter of 2019 and the planned completion is at the end of 2026. Various professional environments shall work multi-disciplinary here to develop new solutions for major challenges within health and sustainability with access to the best and most modern equipment required to carry out world class research, teaching and innovation. Statsbygg requests tenders for an inverted super-resolution microscope with SMLM, SIM and TIRF modality. More detailed information: The super resolution microscope will be placed inside a BSL3 lab and used for the study of pathogenic bacteria and viruses and their interactions with host cells like macrophages or cell cultures. A Super-resolution fluorescent-microscope (SRM) with SIM, SMLM and TIRF that enables high resolution fluorescence microscopy of living microbes (bacteria and fugi), host pathogen-interactions (macrophages and infected cells), and organoids/tissues at single cell level, to be able to study molecular cell localisation and molecular interactions. Shall be equipped with stage incubation chamber with control of CO2 and temperature, and motorised stage with holders for slides and multiwell plates. The system shall be delivered with a computer with a suitable software package for controlling the microscope and analysis and post-processing of images, and in addition a second computer placed outside BSL3 for analysis and post-processing of images in a more convenient location.

Si lors de la vérification de l’offre il s’avère que la capacité en places et les moyens en véhicules ne pourront pas être respectés par lot, l’adjudicateur prendra une décision d’exclusion de l’offre. Si la capacité en places et les moyens en véhicules ne pourront pas être respectés en cumulant les lots, l’organisateur exigera du soumissionnaire de décider quel ou quels lots il maintient.
